# form.addModelChoice

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Add a model choice field to the current form, it opens the models list on press.

```lua
form.addModelChoice(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current model path, relative to the models folder (i.e. "robot.bin" or "Droids/head.bin"), or an empty string if no model is selected |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called with the new model path on selection |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addModelChoice(line, nil, function() return modelPath end, function(newValue) modelPath = newValue end)
```
